name: periodic_twisted_tube
geometry_definition: Circular sections in planes of constant x; center_y(x)=center_y+amplitude*sin(2*pi*x/period), center_z(x)=center_z+amplitude*cos(2*pi*x/period). Positive level set is radius minus transverse distance. One periodic unit of a long tube.
boundary_conditions: Periodic x; impermeable stationary no-slip curved wall. Pressure is a periodic perturbation; mean pressure drop over a period is rho*force_x*period.
comparison: Shared discrete cut geometry at the wall. Compare matching uniform grids before coarsening the native octree interior. Aphros solver equations must remain unmodified.
